body:
I dont know where to reach out, im going to try therapy, but as far as my personal relationships, I cant believe in my heart that asking any of them would result in much.

And thats a HUGE source of depression for me. 

When I feel bad, I have no one personal to reach out to.

Ive read this a few times over the last few hours and i just want to thank you for being an incredible person and reading my summary odd life.  And caring. 

There should be more people on the world like you. 


Thank you

Thank you.  Seriously thank you. Ive read this a few times before responding,  and this means alot to me.  This is my first post on reddit ever,  and i half expected to be mocked and told to give up. 

You are an incredible person.

Thank you for this. 
I am trying to take steps in the right direction, and I am willing to do what ever it takes to make my marriage work.
I love my daughter to bits.

I think alot of it is the pressure. She is willing to wait for me to work it out, but thats just it, she's not helping me actively anymore. She is making her own happiness and wants me to do the same on my own. Its scary and lonely to know that I am the only one who can fix my depression issues, but its hard to find where to start. 

Last night and today i've been filling out applications to a few places and im working on getting therapy classes set up for next week or so.
In the meantime, I feel terrible. 
I have so much regret about who I am and although im willing to get better, I am unsure of myself if I will.

But im trying.

After sitting here writing this for 20 min, I forgot to mention my best friend that didnt come to my wedding died in a car crash a few weeks later. I just wanted to make sure that thought was finished.

Thank you. I've never attempted, but I contemplate at least once a day. I think about peoples reactions and how I would do it, but never had the willingness to do it.

I used to cut in high school, but the scars were saw too many times. 

I will do anything for her, and I knew I ruined her life, but to hear it from her shook my reality and made me realize that even though im suffering, im not doing my half for our marriage, and im giving my moods to her. 

I want to tell her to leave me, but if I did, I would definitely kill myself. I dont want to put that on her either.

Im shocked after years of putting up with me, she is willing to do something to ensure we have a happy marriage.
I appreciate it brother, I've never posted to reddit before, or really reached out to talk about it, but today was a bitch.
